headline: When to Bring in a Pro for Shower Removal
articleBody:
Thinking about tackling that old shower removal yourself? While some DIY projects can be fun and rewarding, removing a shower can quickly turn into a messy, complicated, and even hazardous job if you’re not prepared. There are definitely times when it’s smarter—and safer—to bring in a professional. Knowing when to call in the experts can save you a lot of headaches and potentially costly repairs down the line.

One of the biggest red flags is any evidence of leaks, mold, or rot. If you’ve noticed water stains on your ceiling below the bathroom, a musty smell, or visible mold around your shower, that’s a clear sign of deeper issues. Attempting to remove the shower without properly addressing these problems can spread mold spores or worsen structural damage. Professionals have the tools and expertise to safely mitigate these issues. Similarly, if your bathroom is older, there's a chance of encountering asbestos-containing materials in things like old tile backing or flooring. Disturbing these materials without proper precautions can be dangerous. A professional can identify and handle these materials safely.

Another crucial point is plumbing or framing modifications. If your shower removal is part of a larger remodel that involves relocating drains, changing water supply lines, or altering the wall framing, you're getting into territory that often requires permits and specialized skills. Incorrect plumbing work can lead to leaks, and improper framing can compromise the structural integrity of your bathroom. Even seemingly simple demolition can damage adjacent finishes if not done carefully. A professional contractor like HH Remodeling LLC, serving the greater Denver area from Aurora, knows how to protect your home and ensure all work is up to code. Don't risk a DIY disaster when the pros can handle it efficiently and safely, making your house feel more like a home.
